text: The City is making improvements to Moss Park Arena’s interior, including the washroom, boardroom, snack bar, pro-shop, Zamboni room and multipurpose rooms. Construction at the City-owned facility is expected to take place from June 2027 to May 2028. Moss Park Arena is one of eight arenas in Toronto that are operated by volunteer Arena Boards of Management (Arena Boards), which are City agencies. The board-run arenas provide indoor ice sport facilities along with programming that can include hockey, figure skating and leisure skating. The Arena Board’s mandate includes: a. Ensuring the arena is safe, well-maintained and accessible for use by the local community, neighbourhood organizations and others; b. allocating the use of the arena facility in a way that balances the needs of the local community residents and organizations and user groups; and c. allocating ice-time to users in…
